trap-superlative.notes: CROSS-BLOCK DISAGREEMENT ON THE SAME OBSERVABLE. prop:neutron-qvalue-symbolic gives Q_calc = 0.7836 MeV (+0.17%) for n->p, and tbl:q-beta-spectral-bridge-table-data gives 0.783645803897 MeV; this table gives 0.7816 MeV (-0.10%). The two predictions are 0.25% apart with OPPOSITE error signs, and AGENTS.md's cheat sheet quotes ~0.784 MeV / 0.17%, so 0.7816 is the outlier. Reported, not resolved. Two smaller arithmetic slips in the same table: from the printed inputs the n->p error is -0.0895% (rounds to -0.09%, not -0.10%) and the 3H error is -3.76% (not -3.64%; -3.64% would need Q_calc = 0.017923). The 6He row checks out at +3.68%, and both Q_exp values are right (tritium 18.59 keV, 6He 3.505 MeV).
